changes.before: Data Center Customer (Ratepayer) Protection Act of 2026. Requires large-load users (data centers, AI facilities, crypto mining) to pay their share of electric/infrastructure costs and carry separate billing terms; final version went to a House-Senate conference committee (adopted 2026-05-04/05) which reconciled the House and Senate-amended versions (60-day notice, nearby-landowner and newspaper notice, public meeting, noncompliance fines) before both chambers passed the conference report and it was enrolled, signed, and sent to the Governor.
changes.after: Data Center Customer Ratepayer Protection Act of 2026 requires separate utility tariffs and terms and cost-causation protections for qualifying new data centers, cryptocurrency mining and AI facilities contracting to add at least 75 MW after July 1, 2026. Qualifying land purchases outside municipalities or industrial development parks require notice within 60 days to the Corporation Commission, county commissioners and abutting owners, with penalties for noncompliance. A conference report was adopted before the bill was enrolled and approved.
